about: Record kind for dungeons injected into the leveling route (DungeonRoutes, 2026-11-09). Each run: pick-ups as `when dungeon` steps after (or before) an anchored route goal; `runStop`: the pick-ups repeated at the run's own stop (the cheap, local catch-up for a player who opts in after the earlier pick-ups); the run step after `run.after`, guarded by `when dungeon` + `when onquest <run.objectives>`; each hand-in as a `when complete`/`when onquest` step after its anchor; `budget`: the measured cost vs the solo route (flow audit dynamic + level model). A Forge writer rule or a check reproduces the hand edits from these.
